Task acceptance notes only; no verifier thresholds (task_requirements.json is not used).

notes.align_blocks: Do not lift any block. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.arrange_largest_number: Place each digit upright and readable, not sideways or upside down. Release each digit after placing it. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.arrange_largest_number_random: Place each digit upright and readable, not sideways or upside down. Release each digit after placing it. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.build_tower: Upright supports go under the lower board, another layer under the upper board, and top pieces above it. Keep pieces upright and each layer centered over the one below. Return arms to start.
notes.classify_objects: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.classify_objects_by_language: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.cover_blocks: Keep all cups inverted throughout, including cups already moved away from blocks. Keep blocks in their original positions. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.deposit_coin: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.fasten_screws: Keep matching nuts and bolts upright and align them as accurately as possible so they fully engage. Release the assembly and open both grippers before returning arms to start.
notes.fill_egg_holder: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.fill_pen_holder: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.fold_clothes: Fold each sleeve toward the opposite chest, then fold each hem side toward the matching shoulder. Leave the garment released with both grippers open. Return arms to start.
notes.fold_clothes_random: Fold each sleeve toward the opposite chest, then fold each hem side toward the matching shoulder. Leave the garment released with both grippers open. Return arms to start.
notes.general_pickup: Lift the target object itself more than 10 cm above its initial height.
notes.hang_mugs: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.hang_mugs_random: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.imitate_sorting_sequence: Stay in initial waiting poses until the demonstrator finishes and returns its arm to its initial pose. Leave demonstration objects in their basket while reproducing the sequence. Return arms to start.
notes.insert_tubes: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.make_toast: Put bread slices in separate toaster slots. Leave unused slices in the rack, upright as originally positioned. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.make_toast_random: Put bread slices in separate toaster slots. Leave unused slices in the rack, upright as originally positioned. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.match_and_pick_from_conveyor: Lift the matching target object itself more than 10 cm above its initial height.
notes.organize_table: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.pack_objects_into_box: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.pack_objects_into_box_random: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.pick_from_conveyor_by_image: Lift the basket as instructed, and also lift the target object itself more than 8 cm above its initial height. Place it near the bottom of the basket.
notes.play_stacking_toy: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.play_tic_tac_toe: After placing your piece, return both arms to waiting poses. Stay there until the opponent finishes and returns its arm to its initial pose.
notes.plug_in_charger: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.pour_balls_into_vase: After pouring the balls, return the empty cup upright. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.pour_by_language: Complete pours in the order listed, finishing each before starting the next. After pouring, return each bottle upright.
notes.pour_liquid_into_cup: After pouring, return the bottle to an upright orientation.
notes.pour_liquid_into_cup_random: After pouring, return the bottle to an upright orientation.
notes.press_by_number: Press the first red button as many times as its card says, then press blue to confirm. Repeat with the other red button, then blue again. Fully release each press; no extra presses. Return arms to start.
notes.push_T: Do not lift or tip the T-shaped block while pushing it. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.push_T_random: Do not lift or tip the T-shaped block while pushing it. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.put_bottles_into_dustbin: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.solve_equation: Place each selected number or operator in normal reading orientation, aligned as accurately as possible with existing characters. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.sort_nesting_dolls_by_size: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.sort_nesting_dolls_by_size_random: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.stack_blocks: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.stack_blocks_by_language: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.stack_blocks_random: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.stack_bowls: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.stack_bowls_random: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.store_laptop_and_headphones: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.store_laptop_and_headphones_random: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.store_tools_in_toolbox: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.swap_T: At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.swap_blocks: Lift each block when moving it between mats rather than sliding it. After each transfer, press and fully release the button, with no extra presses. Return arms to start.
notes.sweep_blocks: Leave the dustpan upright on the table, left of the broom. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
notes.sweep_blocks_random: Leave the dustpan upright on the table, left of the broom. At the end, return both arms to their starting positions and orientations.
